title: FAO WaPOR v3 actual evapotranspiration (300 m)
credit: FAO (2023). WaPOR v3: the FAO portal to monitor Water Productivity through Open-access of Remotely sensed derived data. CC BY 4.0.
access: Cloud-optimised GeoTIFFs on Google Cloud Storage (fao-gismgr-wapor-3-data), windowed reads
message: 96 months; mean annual ET 1057 mm; sanity passed
notes: A model estimate of water evaporated and transpired, not a measurement. One 300 m pixel is about the size of a sample block and covers several small fields. Unlike OpenET it is a single model, so no model spread is shown.
